COD.note: Census data is discussed only as a concern in the law debate; no census preparation or count is stated.
Statistical secrecy sanctions are in a statistics law, not a general data protection law.
Nothing on public bodies sharing data.

facts.fact: The Senate ratified unanimously of those voting (73 of 109 senators) ordonnance-loi n° 26/015 of 7 September 2026 organising statistical activity, a 95-article text presented by Vice-Prime Minister Guyllain Nyembo that sets the institutional framework and provides sanctions for breaches of statistical secrecy.

COD.note: The document names a USD 192m budget estimate for the system but no strategy.
